title: Mohnish Pabrai VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
AI, India, Dakshana, and a Charlie Munger 
Story On fear and greed as opportunity, the risk to India if it lacks foundational AI models, the Dakshana sewing-machine story, and the legendary Munger "tell him about the blonde" story.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The speaker identifies an investment opportunity in Constellation Software (CSU) driven by irrational market perspectives surrounding AI. The argument suggests that while the market may be overreacting to AI concerns, incumbents like CSU could actually realize cost reductions and strategic advantages through acquisitions in this environment. The core thesis relies on the disconnect between current market pricing and the potential operational benefits available to established players.
